parsed.name: 仪器服务器客户端
parsed.description: 用于连接实验室仪器管理服务器的客户端组件，可与服务器建立连接、发送请求并断开连接，适合远程仪器访问与实验自动化控制场景。
parsed.description_en: A client component for connecting to a laboratory instrument management server. It can establish a connection, send requests, and disconnect, supporting remote instrument access and lab automation workflows.

actions.description: 连接到仪器管理服务器。
actions.description_en: Connect to the instrument management server.

actions.description: 向服务器发送请求并获取响应。
actions.description_en: Send a request to the server and receive a response.

actions.description: 断开与仪器管理服务器的连接。
actions.description_en: Disconnect from the instrument management server.
